copy.pageDescription: The Forever Sixty apps for iPhone and Android are coming soon: raid sign-ups from the notification, raid night on your lock screen, loot and sim pushes. Sign up to test them.
copy.heading: Forever Sixty for iPhone and Android
copy.lead: Your raid, your loot and your next upgrade, in your pocket.
features: Answer a raid sign-up straight from the notification: In, Late, Bench or Out.
Raid night on your lock screen.
A push when you get loot, or when your sim or report is ready.
Your next upgrade, and where it drops.
